Native-safety: the only import is `react` (useCallback/useEffect/useMemo/useRef/useState) — no react-router, no DOM modules, no `window`, no browser HTML elements, no Recharts/Leaflet/framer-motion, no old web UI components. Intl.DateTimeFormat with timeZone/formatToParts (tzOffsetMs) is the same API the sibling useDateFormat port and converted pages rely on; tzOffsetMs adds a try/catch (mirroring useDateFormat's ymdInTz) so an Intl engine lacking timeZone support degrades to a 0/UTC offset instead of throwing. Unit handling: none — this hook deals only in calendar-day strings + RFC 3339 instants (no Mi/Min/Mph/Kwh fields), so the SI cutover contract is unaffected. i18n intent preserved by keeping each preset's i18nKey/fallback.
